articles.title: Ether is about to lose a steady buyer as Tom Lee says Bitmine will stop token purchases
articles.snippet: Tom Lee said Bitmine will be “done stacking” once it owns 5% of ETH, setting an end date to an accumulation streak that began in mid-2025 and made the company the world's largest Ethereum treasury.

articles.title: Liquidations jump to $547 million as oil rally hits crypto market
articles.snippet: Bitcoin fell below $84,000 as oil climbed on Iranian tanker attacks, while smaller tokens fell harder and liquidations rose to $547 million.

articles.title: Down but not out. Bitcoin's stair-step bullish trajectory is still intact
articles.snippet: Bitcoin dipped to around $84,200 on Wednesday but stayed inside its recent range, keeping the broader bullish stair-step trajectory intact.

articles.title: Bitcoin dips below $84,000 as oil jumps on Iranian tanker attacks
articles.snippet: Bitcoin briefly broke under the level analysts flagged as the point where sellers take over. Oil and the dollar both climbed.

articles.title: Hackers Used AI Agents to Raid a Megachurch's Database, Exposing 850,000 Members
articles.snippet: Seoul's Yoido Full Gospel Church says data on 850,000 members may be compromised, and a security firm found signs AI helped run the attack.
